label: Swing Doors
blurb: The picture splits down the middle and swings open like a pair of doors in 3D, or swings away on one hinge like a single door; the next clip swings shut the same way. Unlike Barn Doors, the halves turn in depth with shading instead of being wiped. Put it on both clips of a cut, or use Progress to key it by hand; the track below shows through the doorway.

params.label: When
choices: In at the start and out at the end
